description:
Cast Chatterfang by paying its mana cost.
When Chatterfang enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Chatterfang with haste plus at least one additional token due to Chatterfang's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Relic of Legends to tap one of the Chatterfang tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Chatterfang.
Holding priority, use the ability of Relic of Legends to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.
